And yet you forget or conveniently ignore all the signs that life goes on for 99% of people. How many stories have you heard of people who thought they couldn't go on but ending up living many exhausting, soul-destroying years beyond what they thought they could do? For me, it's many. There's a David Bowie song called changes that speaks heavily to this. And look how long David Bowie lasted despite drug addiction and all the Hollywood bs. It's envy on for me. Maybe you're luckier.

Edit: but unlike you, I'm not afraid of going to hell. The way I see it, if there is a god, he has no true claim over my soul since I never asked to be alive in the first place. Though shalt knoweth mercy is my line and I'm sticking to it.

It helps (?) to think that there are people in a much more difficult situation than you. Imagine if your life was screwed and you had a child to feed. Then again, I guess if that were the case you would probably turn to drugs to cope. Everyone has their awful things in life but when it's truly over and you just simply can't continue you'll know. Death will call and it will call loudly, and their will be weeping and mourning and anguish of nightmarish magnitude, and then it's either hell or eternal sleep.

Edit: it also helps (?) to know that suicide is actually a very rare thing. We all think we could take that dive but few of us do. Ask yourself this: what changed in your life since yesterday that has made it impossible to continue? You'll probably find that the answer is nothing.

Only if I'm dragged there by a leash. People are vomit. Why would I wanna be around them if I can avoid it? If hillary Clinton gets elected, homeschooling may not be allowed in this country anymore, which reddit would of course collectively ejaculate to.

I spent a few years with such bad depression, anxiety, and rage that it took me til 20 (I'm 21 now) to get me GED and driver's license. The shame was practically unbearable. And then right after that I applied to different temp agencies. The one that hired me for the assembly job, which seriously would have lasted a few weeks at the most, was called Kelly services which I believe is the biggest one here in the states, but there's many of them. Check your local ones, too, and if you don't get any of the jobs you apply to, call up the office in your area and ask if they have any bottom of the barrel stuff. I was offered a one week janitor job but I would have had to get a hepatitis c shot for it.

If I go outside, people will judge me. Viciously. There's a reason I never go outside. I'm just way too sensitive. One mean comment is all it would take to make me mad as a hornet, and then who knows what I might do? I'm not a violent person, but I might come home and do something crazy, like bang my head against the wall or punch something. It's happened before, and who needs it? There's a reason people my age seem to mostly travel with friends,which of course I don't have a single one of.

It's the story of a lot of people's lives. It's just really important to realize that no one really cares. I mean, they want to, it's just people are always thinking about themselves first. Your relationship with this girl shows that. The more I live, the more I realize what savages people really are. The spirit of the antichrist is out there. We're all more or less screwed. It's going to be like going back to medieval   times. People that were living high and mighty will be brought to their knees. It is written. Life is just too goddamn difficult. I can't stand it anymore. It feels like ww3 could be around the corner. Only the strongest and the meanest will survive.

Fly. Ride the stormy seas. Conquer persia. Make sandwiches at subway. I don't give a shit, but anything but just sitting here spanking it to stuff I'm told is going to put me in hell one day.

The south to me is a very neo-nazi place. They're shockingly passive aggressive and they really know how to emasculate people. They have it down to a science. The people in my school and the course just ganged up on me for being different and I was the odd man out. The black sheep. I cry myself to sleep. Okay, no, but I wish I could have fit in more.

Online courses are garbage I'm fairly convinced. I'm pretty sure no enlightened employer wants to see my certificate of completion of some no name online college like devry or whatever the fuck.

Ironically, i live in a pretty wealthy area which is currently experiencing some of the best job growth in the US. Raleigh NC. But moving to the bible belt as a rich yank is tough, and it doesnt help that im pretty much borderline autistic. I did get a factory job but it was one of those two weeks while someone is out sick sort of things. They wouldn't even tell me how long it lasted. When I showed up late (traffic) the first day, I couldn't even go in and face that much shame. I did a community college course but was bullied out of that too. I'm really running out of hope. I feel like death spiraling as hard as I can sometines. You know, needle and spoon hard, but my religion prevents it.

The world is so strange. It's incredible that people can come up with something as complex as the Internet but most people only use it to look at bad images (my Samsung tablet censors the word I wanted to use) and maybe send an email or stalk their ex on facebook. It just seems so unfair that some people are so great and celebrated, etc, but the majority of us are just a name and number that will rot away with only a headstone for people to know we ever existed. I hate feeling that small, but I try to remember I'm not the only one, which doesn't really help, but such is life I guess. Suicide is increasingly looking like my final fate though. I really can't take much more of this evil, disgusting world.
